question: Should TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload become the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for producer-owned transient tool progress?
rationale: The existing fast-mode metadata provides precedent, but this PR expands the external SDK and maintainers must confirm that this generic marker is the intended long-term owner boundary before plugins depend on it.

options.title: Approve generic progress intent
options.body: Keep the additive SDK marker, require the native-block repair and compatibility tests, and document the contract when the repair is ready.

options.title: Keep the signal private
options.body: Move the progress signal behind a narrower internal or owner-plugin boundary and avoid adding a new public SDK symbol.

recommendation.title: Approve generic progress intent
recommendation.body: Keep the additive SDK marker, require the native-block repair and compatibility tests, and document the contract when the repair is ready.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership across the native Slack presentation pipeline and public reply-payload surface affected by this choice.
